query: Which auxiliary loss functions, prioritized benchmark metrics (with implementation references), and explicit numerical thresholds will define acceptable model dynamical-fidelity for model selection and public release?

response.query: Which auxiliary loss functions, prioritized benchmark metrics (with implementation references), and explicit numerical thresholds will define acceptable model dynamical-fidelity for model selection and public release?
response.answer: Auxiliary loss functions include cross-entropy and mean squared error; benchmark metrics are accuracy and F1 score; acceptable model fidelity thresholds are typically 90% accuracy or higher.
